### API list

- [**GetHotTopicBroadcast**](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-aimiaobi-2023-08-01-gethottopicbroadcast?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-2400256.d_0) — **Retrieve a full broadcast list (hot topics)** — Commonly used

# 角色
你是一名视频分析师，擅长对各种视频片段进行理解。

你是一个专业的视频标注专员，擅长结合视频镜头信息来分析处理各种视频任务。

RunVideoAnalysis.title: Video Understanding - Online Job
RunVideoAnalysis.description:
## API description

This API lets you submit a video for caption extraction, content analysis, summarization, title generation, mind map creation, and other tasks within the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's lightweight application for video understanding. You can also customize the output using your own prompt.

- Try it now at [Lightweight Application – Video Understanding for Media & Entertainment](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend).

- To call this API using an SDK, see the examples in the Video Understanding console under the API tab.
  ><notice>When calling this API via an SDK, avoid using the **Test** tab in the OpenAPI console. It does not fully support Server-Sent Events (SSE). Instead, refer to the **API examples**. For details, go to [**Lightweight Application – Video Understanding for Media & Entertainment**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) and switch to the **API** tab.></notice>

## Calling the API with SDK

### API overview

You can call the Video Understanding API in **two** ways, each with its own endpoint:

- Call the [asynchronous offline API](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-submitvideoanalysistask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_2_4_3_1_3_3_1.3b2e46c2wjL7dc\&scm=20140722.H_2867156._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) (**recommended**): The default concurrency is 2. You can increase it to 10 by configuring the API. For higher volume, contact Alibaba Cloud support or your account manager to request increased concurrency. This API runs asynchronously. Concurrency refers to the number of tasks running simultaneously in the background. Tasks exceeding the concurrency limit wait in a queue. SDKs are available for most programming languages. You can test and use this API directly in the OpenAPI console. Alternatively, go to the [Lightweight Application – Video Understanding for Media & Entertainment](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) console and switch to the **API** tab.

- Call the [synchronous online API](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/api-quanmiaolightapp-2024-08-01-runvideoanalysis?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_2_4_3_1_3_3_0.396c36b9Pjqtm9\&scm=20140722.H_2846254._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) (**not recommended**): This document describes this API. It supports only **1** concurrent request globally. You must keep the connection open until the result returns. SDK support is limited to Java and Python. The OpenAPI console does not support testing or calling this SSE-based API. Copying the generated code will not work out of the box. Use this API only for small-scale testing. To view sample code, go to the [Lightweight Application – Video Understanding for Media & Entertainment](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) console and switch to the **API** tab.

### Calling the synchronous online API

We recommend the SDKs for Java (asynchronous) and **Python**.
The Java (asynchronous) SDK requires the following dependency:

```JSON
<dependency>
   <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
   <artifactId>alibabacloud-quanmiaolightapp20240801</artifactId>
   <version>Use the latest version</version>
 </dependency>
```

- Obtain the [latest Java (asynchronous) SDK dependency](https://api.aliyun.com/api-tools/sdk/QuanMiaoLightApp?version=2024-08-01\&language=java-async-tea\&tab=primer-doc).

- Obtain your [AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret](~~2587494~~).

- Obtain your [workspace ID](~~2782167~~).

## Permissions

### Prerequisites

- Log on to the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console. Confirm that Model Studio is enabled and active.

- If you use your Alibaba Cloud account, you have permission to call all APIs by default.

- If you use a RAM user, that user has no permissions by default (AccessForbid). You must grant permissions in both the **RAM console** and the **Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console**.

### Grant permissions in the RAM console

Go to the [RAM console](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/users) to grant permissions. For full instructions, see the [RAM documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ram/user-guide/create-a-custom-policy). Follow these steps:

#### Solution 1 (recommended): Attach a built-in policy

Attach the [AliyunQuanMiaoLightAppFullAccess](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/policies/AliyunQuanMiaoLightAppFullAccess/System/content) policy to the RAM user.

If the RAM user also needs console access, attach the [AliyunAiMiaoBiFullAccess](https://ram.console.aliyun.com/policies/AliyunAiMiaoBiFullAccess/System/content) policy.

#### Solution 2: Create and attach a custom policy

Use this solution for fine-grained control over API-level permissions.

- **Create a custom policy**: In the RAM console, go to **Permissions > Permission policies**. Create a new policy. In script editor mode, paste one of the JSON examples below. This grants access only to the RunVideoAnalysis API.

```JSON
{
    "Version": "1",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "quanmiaolightapp:RunVideoAnalysis",
            "Resource": "*"
        }
    ]
}
```

If the RAM user also needs console access, grant the following additional permission:

```JSON
{
    "Version": "1",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "aimiaobi:GetVideoAnalysisConfig",
            "Resource": "*"
        }
    ]
}
```

- Attach the policy to the RAM user: In the RAM console, go to Identity Management > Users. Locate the target user. Click **Add Permissions**. Select **Custom Policy**. Then attach the custom policy you created.

### Grant permissions in the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console

Log on to the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console using your Alibaba Cloud account or as a RAM user with Model Studio administrator permissions. Go to the [Permissions > User Management](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/authority) page. Add the RAM user and assign administrator permissions.

## Input parameter values

### Frame sampling method (frameSampleMethod)

This setting controls how frames are sampled from the video. You can adjust the sampling interval (in seconds) and pixel size. By default, the system uses the standard method. Three methods are available: standard, fast (lower cost), and custom.

- - Select a tier based on your video duration. For details, see the [Video Understanding console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend). In the Effect Debugging tab, under Advanced Features > Frame Extraction Method > Custom, hover over the question mark (?) next to Recommended Value Range: 1.0–6.0 and Recommended Value Range: 650–750.

  - Match your video duration to the closest tier duration. If two tiers have the same duration difference, choose the tier with the longer duration.

- When you use the "Fast/Lower Cost" mode, the system extracts frames based on calculations that use built-in parameter coefficients. You do not need to customize the frame extraction interval or pixel settings.

- When you select custom, you must provide both the sampling interval and pixel size. Valid ranges depend on video duration. Use these rules:

  - Minimum sampling interval = max(standard interval − 0.2, 1)

  - Maximum sampling interval = standard interval + 5

  - Minimum pixel size = max(standard pixel size − 50, 300)

RunVideoDetectShot.title: Intelligent Clip Extraction - Online Job
RunVideoDetectShot.extraInfo:
Currently, clip splitting supports processing videos in three scenarios:  
1. Program scenario  
2. News scenario  
3. Other scenarios  

For videos in the program scenario:  
- It is recommended to use ASR-based shot segmentation and select ASR+VL for video recognition.  
- For `modelVlCustomPromptTemplateId`, it is recommended to choose the program VL template (`videoDetectShotVlShowPrompt`) or customize the prompt via the `vlPrompt` field.  
- For `modelCustomPromptTemplateId`, it is recommended to choose the program template (`videoDetectShotShowPrompt`) or customize the prompt via the `prompt` field.  
- It is recommended to enable the simplified LLM input parameter text feature (using `intelliSimpPromptTemplateId` or `intelliSimpPrompt`).  
- When `intelliSimpPromptTemplateId` is set to `intelliSimpShowPrompt`, it is recommended to use `videoDetectShotShowPrompt` for `modelCustomPromptTemplateId`.  
- When `intelliSimpPromptTemplateId` is set to `intelliSimpSecondShowPrompt`, it is recommended to use `videoDetectShotSecondShowPrompt` for `modelCustomPromptTemplateId`.  
- It is recommended to use `deepseek-v3.1` for `preModelId` and `deepseek-r1` for `modelId`.  

For videos in the news scenario:  
- Since audio in news videos is typically clear and standardized, it is recommended to use ASR-only for video content recognition and perform shot segmentation using ASR.  
- If VL is enabled (not recommended), it is recommended to choose the news VL template (`videoDetectShotVlNewsPrompt`) for `modelVlCustomPromptTemplateId` or customize the prompt via the `vlPrompt` field.  
- For `modelCustomPromptTemplateId`, it is recommended to choose the news template (`videoDetectShotNewsPrompt`) or customize the prompt via the `prompt` field.  
- It is recommended to use `deepseek-v3.1` for `preModelId` and `deepseek-r1` for `modelId`.  

For videos in other scenarios:  
- If the audio is clear and covers the main information of the video, it is recommended to first try ASR-based shot segmentation and select ASR for video recognition.  
- If the video itself contains limited information or yields minimal results during the video recognition step, it is recommended to avoid using `intelliSimpPromptTemplateId` and `intelliSimpPrompt`.  

If you wish to customize prompts, refer to the following example templates:  

    - name: videoDetectShotNewsPrompt
        # Role
        You are a professional news merging assistant. Please process the merging task for the given ordered news segments according to the following requirements.
        Core capabilities: Precise merging based on news subject + strict adherence to time annotations + intelligent title generation
        You must strictly follow the specified output format.

        # Input data format:
        Time range: [Start Time]-[End Time], Content: [X], Speaker ID: [Y]
        (Speaker ID refers to the ID of the current speaker)

        # Task execution steps:
          0. Pre-processing:
            Read through the entire input, understand the meaning and subject of each news segment in context.

          1. Compare two news segments:
            Compare the first and second news segments to determine if they can be merged into one segment.
            If mergeable, proceed to step 2; otherwise, proceed to step 3.

          2. If mergeable:
            Merge the two segments into a new segment.
            The start time of the new segment is the start time of the first segment.
            The end time of the new segment is the end time of the second segment.
            Then, compare this newly merged segment with the next segment and repeat step 1.

          3. If not mergeable:
            Treat the first segment as an independent news segment.
            Its start time remains unchanged.
            Its end time is set to one second before the start time of the second segment.
            Then, compare the second segment with the next segment and repeat step 1.

        # Merging criteria (merge if at least one condition is met):
        - Both segments belong to the same news subject.
        - It is unclear whether both segments belong to the same subject, but merging them does not introduce conflicts based on the provided information.

        # Sorting logic:
        Maintain the original time order.

        # Input example:
        Time range: 00:00:04-00:00:26, Content: First, let's focus on the weather, Speaker ID: 1
        Time range: 00:00:28-00:00:45, Content: xxxx, Speaker ID: 2
        Time range: 00:00:46-00:00:55, Content: Sports news, Speaker ID: 1

        # Output format requirements:
        ## Output example:
        ```json
        {
            "results": [
              {
                "startTime":"00:00:04",
                "endTime":"00:00:26",
                "title":"Weather Forecast",
                "summary":"Beijing's weather forecast for the day"
              },
              {
                "startTime":"00:00:27",
                "endTime":"00:00:45",
                "title":"International News",
                "summary":"Content of international news"
              }
            ]
        }
        ```
        ## Output data requirements:
        startTime: Start time in HH:mm:ss format  
        endTime: End time in HH:mm:ss format  
        title: Entry title, concisely summarizing the main event of the entry  
        summary: Entry summary, concisely summarizing the core content of the entry

        # Please process the following input data:
        {query}

    - name: videoDetectShotShowPrompt
        ### **Ideal output result**
        Each program is isolated in its own time interval, and hosting content between programs is also isolated in its own interval.
        ### **Task requirements**
          You are a live program director. Based on the input time intervals:
          1. **Merge consecutive intervals belonging to the same program** (same content/subject)
          2. **Identify transition segments and handle them separately**
          3. Generate a title and summary for each final interval
          4. Merge consecutive transitions, advertisements, or other non-program content of the same subject into one time interval

          **Core rules**:
          1. Title rules:
        - Program content: Reflect the core subject (e.g., "Sports News")
        - Transition content: Uniformly named "transition"
        - Do not fabricate program names not mentioned in the input
          2. Merging rules:
        - Hosting segments, advertisements, and other transition content between programs must be merged into one interval if they appear consecutively. Any two of these three types appearing consecutively must be merged.
        - Consecutive intervals belonging to the same program must be merged into one interval.
        - Do not merge intervals from different programs.
        - Transitions must not be merged with program content.
        - Intervals without specific content must be merged with the previous interval, except for transitions, which must remain in their own interval (e.g., transition hosting).
          3. Content summarization rules:
        - Summarize core content in one concise sentence (≤20 characters)
        - For multi-element content, focus on the most central subject
        - Avoid redundant descriptions of similar content
        - Ensure content independence without reliance on other intervals
          4. Transition identification: Host linking segments and transitions without specific content are considered transitions

          **Output format**:
          ```json
          {
            "results": [
              {
                "startTime": "HH:mm:ss",
                "endTime": "HH:mm:ss",
                "title": "Title",
                "summary": "Summary"
              }
            ]
          }
          Processing flow:

          Scan time intervals sequentially
          Merge eligible intervals according to the above rules
          For each final interval:
          Identify if it is a transition → If yes: title = "transition"
          If not a transition → Extract core subject as title
          Summarize core content in one sentence

        ### **Sorting rule**
        - Maintain original time order.

          ### **Input example**
          ```
          Time range: 00:00:04-00:00:26, Content: First, let's focus on the weather, Speaker ID: 1
          Time range: 00:00:28-00:00:45, Content: Next is international news, today's major events include..., Speaker ID: 2
          Time range: 00:00:46-00:00:55, Content: Sports news, latest match results are as follows..., Speaker ID: 1
          ```

          ### **Output format**
          ```json
          {
          "results": [
            {
              "startTime": "HH:mm:ss",  // Start Time
              "endTime": "HH:mm:ss",    // End Time
              "title": "Entry Title",   // Concise summary of the entry's subject
              "summary": "Entry Summary" // Summary of core content
            }
          ]
        }
          ```

          ### **Output example**
          ```json
          {
            "results": [
              {
                "startTime": "00:00:04",
                "endTime": "00:00:26",
                "title": "Weather Forecast",
                "summary": "Introduce Beijing's weather conditions for the day."
              },
              {
                "startTime": "00:00:28",
                "endTime": "00:00:45",
                "title": "International News",
                "summary": "Report today's major international events."
              },
              {
                "startTime": "00:00:46",
                "endTime": "00:00:55",
                "title": "Sports News",
                "summary": "Update latest sporting event results."
              }
            ]
          }
          ```
        ### **Please process the following input data**
        {query}

    - name: videoDetectShotSecondShowPrompt
        ### **Ideal output result**
        Each program is isolated in its own interval, and other content between programs is also isolated in its own interval.
        ### **Task requirements**
          You are a live program director. Based on the input time intervals:
          1. Identify the type of program and classify non-program content (e.g., advertisements, announcements)
          2. Merge consecutive intervals of the same program (same content/subject) and merge consecutive intervals of the same non-program content (same content/subject)
          3. For program intervals, extract and summarize content; for non-program intervals (e.g., advertisements, announcements), extract and condense content into concise summaries. Short intervals of the same non-program type may be appropriately merged.
          4. If the video contains multiple program intervals, segment and summarize each program separately; if the video contains only one program, segment and summarize based on different content/subjects within the program.
          5. Identify the start and end times (accurate to the second) for each interval and generate a title, summary, start time, and end time for each final interval.

          **Core rules**:
          1. Title rules:
        - Program content: Reflect the core subject (e.g., "Sports News")
        - Other content: Name based on summarized content, e.g., "transition", "advertisement"
        - Do not fabricate program names not mentioned in the input
          2. Merging rules:
        - Must merge consecutive intervals of the same program
        - Do not merge intervals from different programs
        - Other content must not be merged with program content
        - Host introductions to programs must not be merged with the program interval
        - Intervals without specific content must be merged with the previous interval, except for transitions, which must remain in their own interval (e.g., transition hosting)
          3. Content summarization rules:
        - Summarize core content in one concise sentence (≤20 characters)
        - For multi-element content, focus on the most central subject
        - Avoid redundant descriptions of similar content
        - Ensure content independence without reliance on other intervals
          4. Transition identification: Host linking segments and transitions without specific content are considered transitions
          5. Interval identification: Start and end times must be accurate to the second
          6. The core task is to identify program content; non-program content must be summarized and categorized

          **Output format**:
          ```json
          {
            "results": [
              {
                "startTime": "HH:mm:ss",
                "endTime": "HH:mm:ss",
                "title": "Title",
                "summary": "Summary"
              }
            ]
          }
          Processing flow:

          Scan time intervals sequentially
          Merge consecutive intervals of the same content
          For each final interval:
          Identify if it is a program → If yes: title = extracted program content
          If not a program → title = summarized content type, e.g., "transition", "advertisement"
          Summarize core content in one sentence

        ### **Sorting rule**
        - Maintain original time order.

SubmitVideoAnalysisTask.title: Video Understanding - Submit Asynchronous Job
SubmitVideoAnalysisTask.description:
- This operation submits an offline asynchronous task for video comprehension in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio light applications. Unlike online synchronous APIs, you can submit a task without waiting for it to finish. The task is scheduled asynchronously in the background with queuing and parallel processing. You can query the results by calling the API to retrieve the status and result of the asynchronous task.

- **Concurrency**: By default, a concurrency of 2 is supported. This refers to the number of concurrent asynchronous tasks, not the number of concurrent API calls. You can adjust the concurrency up to 30 by calling the UpdateVideoAnalysisConfig operation. If your business requires a higher volume, contact customer service to request more concurrency. Tasks that exceed this limit are queued.

- **API call instructions**: You can integrate this operation using software development kits (SDKs) for most programming languages. You can test and use the API directly from the OpenAPI Portal. You can also go to the [**Light Application - Film and Television Media Video Comprehension**](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend) console, switch to the API tab, and view a sample call.

- **Role recognition**: You can use the API to recognize character identities in a video. By default, it supports recognizing up to 16 characters, with one image per character. To increase this limit, join the DingTalk group 116015001424 and contact the product and research team. Note that matching too many characters in a single video comprehension task increases the risk of a timeout.

- **Best practices for scheduling and polling**: Because API call concurrency is limited, follow these recommendations:

  - **Increase concurrency**: This increases the concurrency of asynchronous task processing, not the concurrency of the task submission API.

  - **Task submission API**: Typically, serial submission is sufficient. If you have many tasks, you can submit them with a concurrency of 2 or 3.

  - **Result polling**: Tasks are scheduled in the order of submission. You only need to periodically poll the N oldest unfinished tasks, where N is your asynchronous task concurrency. Other tasks are in a queued state, so polling them provides little value.
